mod.description: Health and energy regenerate (or stay full), insanity fades and sleep deprivation builds up slower.
Enabled.name: Mod enabled
Enabled.description: Turns the mod on or off (takes effect immediately).
HealthPerSecond.name: Health per second
HealthPerSecond.description: Health points the player regains per second (0 = off). Also works during combat.
HealthPerSecond.hint: Health points regained per second (0 = off).
InfiniteHealth.name: Infinite health
InfiniteHealth.description: The player no longer takes damage and always has full health. If a scene waits for the player to take damage or die, it cannot continue. Turn this off briefly then.
EnergyPerSecond.name: Energy per second
EnergyPerSecond.description: Energy the player regains per second (0 = off). The bar goes up to 100.
EnergyPerSecond.hint: Energy regained per second (0 = off, the bar goes up to 100).
InfiniteEnergy.name: Infinite energy
InfiniteEnergy.description: Work no longer costs energy, the bar stays full and no task fails for lack of energy. This also means working while sleep-deprived no longer adds insanity.
InfiniteEnergy.hint: Work costs no energy, the bar stays full.
InsanityReductionPerSecond.name: Insanity reduction per second
InsanityReductionPerSecond.description: How much insanity fades per second (0 = off). Insanity lowers your maximum energy (maximum = 100 - insanity) and rises with every task while sleep-deprived. If you need insanity for certain recipes, set this to 0.
InsanityReductionPerSecond.hint: Insanity fading per second (0 = off). Less insanity = more maximum energy.
SleepDeprivationSpeed.name: Sleep deprivation speed
SleepDeprivationSpeed.description: How fast sleep deprivation builds up. 1.0 = vanilla (debuff after 2 days without sleep), 0.5 = after 4 days, 0 = never. A debuff that is already active only goes away with the next sleep.
SleepWithFullEnergy.name: Sleep with full energy
SleepWithFullEnergy.description: The bed no longer refuses with "no need to sleep" when your energy bar is full. Important because the game only saves when you sleep. With full energy the sleep is just short.
SleepWithFullEnergy.hint: The bed no longer refuses when your energy is full. Important for saving.
WorkSpeed.name: Your work speed at tables
WorkSpeed.description: How much progress each of your hits makes when you work at a table yourself, such as workbenches, the autopsy and embalming table or the study table (1.0 = normal, up to 10x). Every hit still costs energy as usual, so a craft costs less energy in total. Recipes above your mastery stay locked.
WorkSpeed.hint: More progress per hit when you work at a table yourself (1.0 = normal).
